title: Hepatic fibrosis 2022: Unmet needs and a blueprint for the future

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Hepatic fibrosis 2022: Unmet needs and a blueprint for the future》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Steady progress over four decades toward understanding the pathogenesis and clinical consequences of hepatic fibrosis has led to the expectation of effective antifibrotic drugs, yet none has been approved.
